facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports Minister Kibassa Maliba said on 28 September 2026 that RDC-PASS, launched in June to identify and authenticate Congolese for digital services, entered a first operational phase in September with 50 enrolment agents trained.

Agence Ecofin reports the Prime Minister has signed the decree creating the Agence nationale de certification électronique, which is to frame electronic certification, as the minister said on 28 September 2026.

COD.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
No enrolment count or share is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Who operates or maintains RDC-PASS is not stated.
No register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports the ministry presents RDC-PASS, launched in June by President Tshisekedi, as a tool to identify Congolese, now in a first operational phase since September 2026 with 50 enrolment agents trained and rollout to widen gradually.
